turns.text: Now you've, you're good at this, you've got a whole list of inventions.
turns.zh: 现在你，你很擅长这个，你有一大堆发明点子。

turns.text: You love, you love inventing… I know, that could take the whole time but, for you Laura?
turns.zh: 你爱，你爱发明……我知道，那可能会占掉整段时间，但对你来说，Laura？
什么东西现在还不存在，但应该有？

turns.text: Um… well I could be really like, ‘Miss World’ about it and say ‘World Peace,’ you know?
turns.zh: 嗯……好吧，我可以特别像『世界小姐』那样说『世界和平』，你知道吧？

turns.text: like that… that's something that you could say… Don’t say that, don’t say that.
turns.zh: 就像那样……那是你可以说的话……别说那个，别说那个。

turns.text: Um, okay I would love um…
See, like, I always come across these things but then I never remember what they are… something that um… okay I know what it is.
turns.zh: 你看，就像，我总是碰到这些东西，但然后我从来记不住它们是什么……一个嗯……好吧我知道是什么了。
